basic_details.job_title: Thane Municipal Corporation Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 61 Staff Nurse, MPW Posts
basic_details.short_information: Thane Municipal Corporation (TMC) has released the TMC Recruitment 2026 notification for 61 contractual posts under the Fifteenth Finance Commission program in its Public Health Department. The vacancies are for GNM (Female), GNM (Male), and Multi-Purpose Worker (MPW) posts. Eligible candidates holding a BSc Nursing/GNM qualification or 12th pass with a paramedical certificate can apply through the official Google Form link before the last date. how_to_apply: Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Open the Google Form application link: https://forms.gle/mAvs13sQEWN2wKXh8
Fill in all required personal, educational, and experience details accurately.
Upload self-attested scanned copies of the required certificates.
Submit the form before the last date, i.e., 07/08/2026, up to 2:00 PM.

Important note on application mode: The notification contains two sets of instructions on submitting the application. One section states that applications in the prescribed format should be submitted at the 4th Floor, Public Health Department, Thane Municipal Corporation Building, Sarsenapati General Arunkumar Vaidya Marg, Chandanwadi, Panchpakhadi, Thane (West) - 400602, by 07/08/2026 up to 2:00 PM. A separate section states that all candidates must fill the application only through the online Google Form within the stipulated period. This is not clarified further in the provided notification, and candidates are advised to verify with the official TMC website (www.thanecity.gov.in) whether the Google Form is the sole application mode or whether a physical copy must also be submitted at the stated address.
important_instructions: Submission of the application form does not by itself confirm a candidate's eligibility; eligibility is assessed based on the information and documents provided. Any changes or corrections cannot be made to the application after it has been submitted. Candidates must mention their own valid, currently active email ID and mobile number in the application; this must remain accessible until the recruitment process is complete. Candidates from reserved categories must submit the relevant caste/category certificate; applications of reserved-category candidates without this certificate will not be considered. Candidates from Other Backward Classes, Vimukta Jati, Nomadic Tribes, Special Backward Class, and Socially and Educationally Backward Class categories must submit a valid non-creamy layer certificate at the time of document verification, if selected. Knowledge of the Marathi language is required. These posts are purely contractual and are not regular posts of the State Government; candidates cannot claim absorption into a regular government post based on this contractual engagement. The Commissioner, Thane Municipal Corporation, holds all rights regarding the recruitment and selection process, including the right to modify or cancel the process, in part or fully, as needed. No individual communication will be made to candidates regarding the recruitment process; updates will be published only on the official website, www.thanecity.gov.in. Applications and documents received after the last date and time will not be considered, and no claims on this account will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: TMC GNM & MPW Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be engaged on a contractual basis for 11 months and 29 days, and paid a consolidated monthly remuneration as follows: The notification clarifies that these are consolidated contractual posts and not regular state government posts; selected candidates cannot claim regularization on a permanent government post.

content_sections.heading: TMC GNM & MPW Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee must be paid through a Demand Draft from a nationalized bank, drawn in favour of "Integrated Health and Family Welfare Society." The application fee is non-refundable.

content_sections.heading: TMC GNM & MPW Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made on a 100-point merit scale based on the following criteria: Marks obtained in the qualifying exam (final year), converted to a percentage-based proportion out of 50 marks Additional educational qualification beyond the minimum required, up to a maximum of 20 marks Relevant work experience in the post applied for, at 6 marks per year, up to a maximum of 30 marks Based on this merit list, candidates will be called for document verification in a 1:3 ratio against the number of vacancies. Candidates absent on the day of document verification will be declared ineligible, and the next eligible candidate on the merit list will be given a chance.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for TMC GNM & MPW Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Experience certificates (where claimed), clearly stating the duration of service Caste/category certificate, and non-creamy layer certificate for OBC/VJ/NT/SBC/EWS candidates where applicable Domicile certificate confirming Maharashtra residency Marriage registration certificate or Gazette notification, if the candidate's name has changed MS-CIT certificate, if held Small Family declaration/certificate Recent passport-size photograph with self-signature

faq.question: Q1. What is TMC GNM & MPW Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Thane Municipal Corporation to fill 61 contractual posts of GNM (Female), GNM (Male), and Multi-Purpose Worker (MPW), under the Fifteenth Finance Commission scheme, in the Public Health Department.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in TMC GNM & MPW Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 61 vacancies are available: 28 for GNM (Female), 3 for GNM (Male), and 30 for MPW (Male).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for TMC GNM & MPW Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 07/08/2026, up to 2:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for TMC GNM & MPW Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: GNM (Female) and GNM (Male) posts require a BSc Nursing/GNM course with MNC registration. The MPW post requires 12th pass in Science along with a Paramedical Basic Training Course or Sanitary Inspector Course.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for TMC GNM & MPW Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years for all posts. The maximum age is 38 years for GNM (Female) and GNM (Male), and 65 years for the MPW post, as stated in the post-wise table in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for TMC GNM & MPW Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹750/- for open category candidates and ₹500/- for reserved category candidates, payable through a nationalized bank Demand Draft in favour of "Integrated Health and Family Welfare Society." The fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for TMC GNM & MPW Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the Google Form link provided in the notification: https://forms.gle/mAvs13sQEWN2wKXh8.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for TMC GNM & MPW Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a 100-point scale covering qualifying exam marks, additional educational qualification, and relevant experience. Shortlisted candidates are called for document verification in a 1:3 ratio against the number of vacancies.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for TMC GNM & MPW posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration is ₹20,000/- for GNM (Female) and GNM (Male), and ₹18,000/- for the MPW post.

faq.question: Q10. What is the contract duration for these TMC posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be engaged on a contractual basis for a period of 11 months and 29 days.
